text:
alex: heads up - after last night's keystore certchain rotation in us-west-2 we're seeing ~7% of GPU node joins fail with keystore handshake timeout
maria: seeing same, a bunch of warm-pool boots erroring with `keystore: tls handshake timeout` in the bootstrap logs
sam: timeline? which rotation PR? any firewall or privatelink changes accompanying it?
alex: rotation pushed at ~02:14 UTC, privatelink cert chain updated. no planned firewall changes that I know of. ops-bot: certchain v2026.03.20 deployed by @lisa
jun: digging through logs now — some nodes get `407 Proxy Auth Required` from keystore-proxy, others hit `EOF` after ~512 bytes during handshake. feels like the certchain length increased packet size -> MTU/proxy chunking issue
maria: example snippet: ```[bootstrap] keystore handshake failed: EOF after 512 bytes
[keystore-proxy] upstream error GET /v1/auth -> 407 Proxy Auth Required```
sam: is this specific to us-west-2? any cross-region impact?
alex: only us-west-2 so far. warm-pool success rate across region dropped from 99% -> ~92% after rotation
lisa: rotation script concatenated CA bundle differently (new intermediate chain included). some privatelink proxies treat long TLS client hello oddly. i pushed a mitigation to proxy config but need rollback plan
jun: quick mitigation — opened a temporary bypass rule to route keystore traffic around the privatelink proxy for warm-pool subnets in us-west-2: https://console.internal/sg-rules/sg-0a1b2c3d
maria: after bypass the warm-pool join success jumped to 96% in the last 12m. this confirms proxy is the choke point
sam: good catch. we still have an audit problem: audit logs for keystore requests are missing for a ~10m window around the rotation (02:10-02:20 UTC)
lisa: ugh — the rotation step that rewrote the audit bundle used a temporary file + atomic mv; apparently the dump process truncated the live audit log during the copy. i didn't catch that in staging because of smaller traffic
ops-bot: incident created: INC-20260320-17 (keystore-handshake-us-west-2) by maria
ajun: (note: jun is me, typo) => jun: action plan suggestion: 1) re-run rotation with streaming append (avoid mv) (lisa) 2) add 1% canary verify before region-wide switch (sam) 3) extend warm-pool bootstrap retry + backoff to tolerate proxy hiccups (jun)
maria: i'll file a parent ticket and attach runbook steps and the temporary bypass rule details
lisa: PR is open with safer rotation logic + staged rollout: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/6789
sam: monitoring dashboards to watch: https://metrics.internal/keystore/handshake?region=us-west-2 (handshake failures), and https://metrics.internal/warm-pool/success-rate
security-bot: acknowledged — security will validate rotation attestation and we will replay audit events into the audit trail for compliance. please add exact timestamps to the ticket
alex: recommended immediate steps: 1) keep bypass in place for next 2 hours while we re-run with safe writer 2) deploy proxy config that accepts longer client hello with streaming parse (lisa) 3) schedule a canary re-deploy at 03:30 UTC (sam)
maria: notifying affected Dedicated customers with clusters in us-west-2 via status page update and direct outreach
sam: +1 on canary. also we'll add e2e test to rotation job that verifies audit log continuity post-rotate
lisa: will re-run rotation at 03:10 UTC with streaming writer and staged 1% traffic canary, will follow up here with results
jun: thanks everyone — leaving notes in runbook about MTU/proxy edge cases and the mitigation steps
maria: thanks all, keep updates here. if anyone needs to join for the 03:10 run please ping
alex: ping @security-team for formal post-rotate attestation
security-bot: we will join the postmortem and confirm audit replay window. assigning to sec-rotation-review
maria: :thumbsup:
